name: builder
description: Build and deploy apps from git: BuildKit (containerd worker) and ziroctld, the deploy daemon behind `ziroctl deploy`

files.content:
# Managed by `ziroctl module enable builder`. Images go straight into containerd's default namespace,
# where `ziroctl deploy` runs them; the OCI worker (its own image store) is off.
root = "/var/lib/buildkit"
[grpc]
  address = ["unix:///run/buildkit/buildkitd.sock"]
[worker.oci]
  enabled = false
[worker.containerd]
  enabled = true
  address = "/run/containerd/containerd.sock"
  namespace = "default"
  gc = true
  # Build cache kept on disk (MB): older layers are collected first
  gckeepstorage = 10000

services.name: ziroctld
services.description: Ziro deploy daemon: builds and releases apps from git
